text:
alex: T-minus 15 for the quant-runner rollout to prod (us-west-2). Canary plan: 1% for 10m -> 10% for 5m. Who's on smoke and who's rollback lead?

maria: I'll own smoke checks (latency + 5xx).

sam: I'll be rollback lead and standby on the command.

tia: Staging smoke was clean earlier. Quick Q: are we enabling the new KV cache for canary?

alex: not for initial canary — keep KV cache off to reduce surface area. We'll enable on 10% if all good.

jen: Can someone run the healthcheck curl once canary is live? I'll watch dashboards and notify CS.

leo: I'll tag canary traffic and set thresholds. Ready to flip routing.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex at 2664789027 — pipeline r-2026-42. Status: queued.

alex: Quick checklist:
- infra flag set?
- CS/Support notified?
- smoke healthcheck run?
- no 5xx spike?
- rollback lead confirmed?

Posting the smoke check command we'll use:

```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  "https://api.prod-us-west-2.redwood/v1/quant-runner/health" | jq '.status, .latency'
```

maria: running the smoke in ~2m once canary is applied.

sam: rollback steps documented (I'll paste):

```bash
# quick rollback options
kubectl rollout undo deployment/quant-runner -n prod
# or pin to previous image
kubectl set image deployment/quant-runner quant-runner=sha-old -n prod
```

tia: Rule of thumb: if P95 latency > 200ms OR error ratio > 1% sustained for 3m -> rollback. Add to playbook.

jen: CS pinged in #customer-announce and on-call notified. :white_check_mark:

leo: toggling canary routing now (starting at 2664789035). Metrics collection on.

maria: smoke results (canary 1%): P95=120ms, 5xx=0.02%. No spikes. :thumbsup:

alex: awesome. Sam, you still ready to trigger rollback if needed?

sam: standing by. I'll trigger at first sustained breach, latest by 2664789060 if I see regression.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic at 1% applied. Health check passed. Pipeline step r-2026-42 -> canary succeeded.

alex: plan to promote to 10% in 5m if no regressions. Everyone acknowledge?

maria: ack

sam: ack

tia: ack

jen: ack — monitoring dashboards up.

leo: ack — routing rules ready.

alex: thanks all — will post final promote timestamp. Keep this channel for live notes only.
